verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's structure and hierarchy, but the SOLSTICE wordmark is centred and no longer lines up with the headline's left edge. The subhead is indented off that edge too, the pills sit cramped under the subhead, and the CTA button nearly touches the bottom edge. B blows the headline up to three lines with an orphaned "back" and shrinks the CTA to a tiny pill the same size as the badges, so the call to action is buried. B also wraps the subhead into a narrow three-line scrap and crams the CTA, badges and subhead into the bottom-right corner, leaving the phone floating above them.
